rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: The notification is a 3.96 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Vetlanda, status 'notified'. Completed felling overlaps 3.0% (fellings from 2007, 2011 and 2017), so this is not ALREADY_FELLED.

No eligible species within 250 m. The only red-listed record there is Arnica montana (VU, 182 m, 2017, 2 records, unc 10 m). The tool flags it as not forest-associated and not felling-relevant, so it is not eligible.

One eligible species lies beyond 250 m: Gyalecta ulmi (EN lichen, site-bound, forest-associated, 1 record at 586 m, 2017, unc 75 m). Its felling-relevant factors are lack of continuity forest, lack of large or old trees, changed stand structure and changed tree-species composition. This matches the rubric MEDIUM rule.

Effort within 1000 m is adequate: 169 records, 73rd percentile, against a county median of 58.5. Within 250 m there are 2 records on 1 day (1 species), none inside the polygon. The county median within 250 m is 1.

uncertainties: The only eligible record is a single lichen record from 2017 (about 9 years old) at 586 m with 75 m uncertainty. The polygon's equivalent radius is 112 m, so the record may say little about the stand.
Near-site recording is very thin: 2 records from one observation day within 250 m. The lack of eligible species close by is weak evidence.
not_established: Whether Gyalecta ulmi or any red-listed species occurs on the polygon.
Forest character or stand age: the tools do not state it.
Whether felling is legal or harmful.
Absence of species on or next to the site, including sensitive species hidden in public data.
next_action: A reviewer should check the 2017 Gyalecta ulmi record (GBIF link in E-31950) against the polygon and nearby habitat. Consider a field check, since near-site recording is sparse.
